description: Removes a clip from the timeline. Pass sequenceId when the clip ID came from list_sequence_tracks for a non-active sequence.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip on the timeline to remove

deleteMode.description: Whether to ripple delete (close gap) or lift (leave gap)

sequenceId.description: Optional sequence ID to search. If omitted, searches the active sequence first, then all sequences.

name: remove_from_timeline
